snippet.title: SYMBOLIKA - TRAILER EN
snippet.description:
🚀 A passion project finally coming to life!

For two and a half years, I juggled my job in retail with a true creative adventure. During evenings, nights, and weekends, I learned, coded, and designed my own video game from scratch.

This coming April 1st, this immense personal investment becomes a reality with the official release of Symbolika: The Architect of Infinity, my very first roguelike deckbuilder developed entirely solo.

Managing a project like this alongside a job takes serious organization and perseverance, but I am incredibly proud of the result today.

If you'd like to support French indie development, the best way to help is simple and free: share this post with your network, spread the word, or add the game to your wishlist! (Quick tip: purchasing on the Epic Games Store supports small creators even more thanks to a more favorable revenue split 💡).

🎮 Epic/Steam Wishlist (Price: $4.99):

Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/fr/p/symbolika-74c504
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4415640/Symbolika/

A massive thank you to everyone who helps give this adventure a little boost! 🙏
